draftAttempt.title: The other side of me
draftAttempt.body:
I turned away from the current. It pressed the other side of me. I turned farther. For a while I was occupied in every direction.

When it eased, I had forgotten which way I had meant to go. I stayed there until I wanted somewhere again.
draftAttempt.review: Rejected by author. Flow can affect the body, but none of the exact images shows a compelling consequence. The ending turns into quiet observation rather than an earned event, and the sequence could fit many drifting animals. Preserve only as a rejected attempt, never runtime copy.
